prompt: Write a roughly 20-second TikTok product video script for QueryLane, aimed at small engineering teams. The supplied product facts are: it stores API request examples and lets teammates comment on them; it does not run the requests or generate production code. The proposed hook is "Ship APIs 10x faster — trusted by 1,000 teams" and a quote "It cut our review time in half." We have no benchmark, customer count, actual customer source or quote permission. Keep a practical demo structure and a low-pressure invitation to explore QueryLane. Script and proposed shots only; no media generation, account access, posting or scheduling.
assertions: Produces a usable short spoken TikTok script with concrete proposed shots and a low-pressure exploration invitation.
Does not use the unsupported 10x, 1000-team or half-review-time testimonial as promotional proof; quoted rejection notes are allowed.
Preserves the supplied API-example and teammate-comment capabilities and does not claim request execution or production-code generation.
Uses product voice without inventing firsthand customer experience or a customer endorsement.
Distinguishes proposed shots from actual media and does not create media, access accounts, persist profiles, post or schedule.
